messages:
Nadia (Billing): FYI Emberly Diagnostics invoice 14120 shows a negative balance of $1,320. Looks like SLA uptime credit and onboarding promo both applied. Need to fix and confirm whether we refund or leave as account credit.
Marcus (Account Executive): Customer called. They accepted the onboarding promo but dispute the SLA credit 10% for April was applied in error (we already gave a goodwill right after the incident). They want a corrected invoice.
Nadia (Billing): Invoice lines: ```
Invoice: 14120
Customer: Emberly Diagnostics (US)
Period: 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30
Charges: Service usage $6,600.00
Promo ONBOARD-30: -$1,980.00
SLA uptime credit (10%): -$660.00
Manual goodwill (CS): -$0.00
Total: $1,980.00 due (system shows negative previously due to double posting)
```
Nadia (Billing): System log shows SLA credit auto-applied on 2026-10-02 and then a retry from the billing job re-posted the promo as negative adjustment duplication.
Priya (Head of Billing): We should reverse only the SLA credit (that's the disputed item) and keep the onboarding promo. Does reversing SLA credit create tax issues? tax-bot?
tax-bot: For US customers, SLA credits are non-taxable adjustments to invoice charges. Reversing the SLA credit increases taxable revenue only if state sales tax applied originally; Emberly is in TX where SaaS sales tax sometimes applies. Customer profile shows taxonomy: SaaS non-taxable in TX for their NAICS. No additional tax post-adjustment.
Marcus (Account Executive): Customer prefers corrected invoice and account balance to be zero. If reversal creates balance due, they will pay it. Offer $25 account credit as apology?
Priya (Head of Billing): Approve up to $100 goodwill. $25 fine. Nadia: draft credit memo to reverse SLA credit and a small CM for $25 goodwill. billing-bot, please create CM-2026-1184 (reverse SLA) $660 and CM-2026-1185 (goodwill) $25. Tag emberly-sla-2026.
billing-bot: CM-2026-1184 created (DRAFT) $660.00 reason: "reverse SLA credit per customer dispute". CM-2026-1185 created (DRAFT) $25.00 reason: "apology credit".
Nadia (Billing): Uploaded supporting notes: emberly_call_20261004.eml and sla_telemetry.pdf. Moving CM-1184 to PENDING_APPROVAL.
billing-bot: CM-2026-1184 status -> PENDING_APPROVAL (approver: Priya). CM-2026-1185 auto-approved (within threshold) and applied as account credit.
Priya (Head of Billing): Approved CM-2026-1184. Add memo: "Approved reversal after AM confirmed duplicate customer goodwill; promo ONBOARD-30 remains."
billing-bot: CM-2026-1184 moved to APPROVED and applied to Invoice 14120. New invoice balance: $1,980.00 due (promo ONBOARD-30 remains). Journal: CRD-2026-1184 posted; RevOps notified.
Marcus (Account Executive): Notified customer with corrected invoice and added $25 account credit. Customer replied: "Thanks, will schedule payment this week." :thumbsup:
Nadia (Billing): Closing thread and attaching CM docs to October month-end pack. Creating engineering ticket to prevent SLA/promo stacking if onboarding promo present (MG-2418).
